_readme: HUMAN OVERRIDES for pt-br. This file is hand-maintained and always wins.
scripts/translate.mjs READS this file and merges it on top of DeepL's
output. It never writes to, modifies, or deletes this file.
To fix a bad translation, add the key HERE -- do not edit pt-br.json,
which is regenerated and overwritten on every run.
Every entry below was written by Claude, not a native speaker. See
TRANSLATION_NOTES.md for what was wrong with each one and its review
status. Nothing here has been verified by a human.
Keys must match public/locales/en.json. {placeholder} tokens and emoji
must match the English exactly -- the generator validates overrides on
the same terms as generated text and refuses to write the locale if they
don't. (JSON has no comment syntax, hence this _readme key; the merge
only considers keys that exist in en.json, so it is inert.)
